domain: Reusable AI-friendly FastAPI backend template. The kernel ships a CompositionRoot, semantic NDJSON logging, an LLMService with mock-first ADR-003 default, and the Mayak AI tooling (query CLI, validators, doctor, skills). Verticals (RAG / agents / domain-specific services) are added on top by extending build_reference_services and wiring typed dependency aliases.

reference_task.description: The one vertical the kernel ships, and it exists to be copied: domain model -> port -> psycopg repository -> application service -> DTOs -> endpoint -> unit tests -> functional tests, plus the three wiring edits. Storage-only on purpose; it touches no LLM. Routes are registered only when POSTGRES_ENABLED is true. Every file is named reference_task*, so a project deletes the example in one command once its own vertical works. See .agents/skills/add-vertical/SKILL.md.

postgres.description: Optional relational store, on by default. POSTGRES_ENABLED=false makes the kernel start without a connection pool, skip Alembic, and drop the database from the readiness contract — for a service that needs only vector search or no persistence at all. Verticals add their own repositories and migrations on top when it is enabled.

openai_compatible_llm.description: OpenAI-compatible API consumed by project.infrastructure.agents.LLMService. Default mode is mock (ADR-003); set AGENT_LLM_MODE=live and OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY to call a real provider.

glossary.vertical: A self-contained feature slice spanning domain, application, infrastructure, and test layers.
glossary.composition_root: The single location (project/core/composition_root.py) where shared services are constructed and injected into FastAPI's app.state.
glossary.service_registration: Per-vertical service-construction helpers in project/core/service_registration.py (build_reference_services and verticals' own builders).
glossary.wiring_hotspot: One of the four files that bind layers together; the list is in CLAUDE.md under 'How the kernel is shaped'.
glossary.edit_zone: Risk classification of a file: safe (small blast radius), caution (wiring change), expert (kernel/generators), generated_do_not_edit.
glossary.kernel: The reusable template surface — AI tooling, validators, composition root, semantic logging — meant to be inherited by every project built on Mayak.
glossary.reference_implementation: An example feature added on top of the kernel. The scaffold ships exactly one - the reference_task vertical - as the shape to copy and then delete.
glossary.mock_mode: Deterministic LLMService behaviour controlled by AGENT_LLM_MODE=mock. ADR-003 makes mock the default for local dev and CI.

api_overview.notes: No shared API prefix: each router declares its own, and include_application_routers mounts it at the root. Kernel routes are GET /health/ and GET /health/ready; the shipped reference vertical adds POST /reference-tasks, GET /reference-tasks/{task_id} and GET /reference-tasks, registered only when POSTGRES_ENABLED is true. A project that wants a /api/v1 prefix adds it in router_registration.py and updates this field.

project_decisions: FastAPI + uvicorn as the HTTP runtime (project/launcher/main.py).
Clean architecture with vertical slicing: domain → application → infrastructure, composed in project/core/composition_root.py.
Semantic NDJSON logging (project/core/logging/) with prepend_trace_summary on shutdown.
Mock-first LLMService default (ADR-003) so the kernel is runnable and CI is deterministic without a real provider.
langchain-core and langchain-openai are dependencies because LLMService imports them; nothing else from that ecosystem ships by default.
